title: H3205 (122nd General Assembly): Concealable weapons

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2016-12-15; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/3205_20161215.htm (LegiScan doc 1439466))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2016-12-15. Struck: 'when carrying out the duties of their office' and the word 'active' before each office; added: 'active or retired' and item (13) clerks of court.

operative_text: Section 1 (Section 23-31-240): Notwithstanding any other provision contained in this article, the following persons who possess a valid permit pursuant to this article may carry a concealable weapon anywhere within this State, active or retired: (1) Supreme Court justices; (2) judges of the court of appeals; (3) circuit court judges; (4) family court judges; (5) masters-in-equity; (6) probate court judges; (7) magistrates; (8) municipal court judges; (9) federal judges; (10) administrative law judges; (11) solicitors and assistant solicitors; (12) workers' compensation commissioners; and (13) clerks of court.
